emma (sec): Heads-up: new upstream vuln batch. Two items that matter to us: CVE-2026-3141 (grpc-go header parsing -> potential DoS) and CVE-2026-3142 (oauth/jwt lib token validation edge-case). net/http advisory looks info-only for now but might affect older go1.19 builds.

raj (eng-runtime): thanks. can you paste links?

emma (sec): Sure: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-3141 and https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-3142. Quick summary: grpc fix is a header sanitization + bounds-check tightener. jwt fix addresses alg=none parsing when certain claims are empty (rare but possible for token exchange flows).

luis (runtime): grpc impact: our hosting path uses grpc unary + streaming. We saw some malformed headers in logs last month from noisy clients but nothing exploited. prioritization: grpc -> P0, jwt -> P1 unless we confirm token exchange usage in infra.

taylor (sre): agree. grpc P0. plan: patch runtime images, canary to dedicated-us-west first, monitor 5m p99 and error spikes. deploy-bot can start canary once PR merged.

sam (platform): For jwt, we need to audit all calls to oauth token introspection and any third-party integrations. I can search service inventory and tag services that verify tokens client-side.

raj (eng-runtime): OK. I opened a draft PR to bump grpc: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/412 — bumps google.golang.org/grpc to v1.60.2 and adds small sanitization test. Also a companion go.mod replace in some internal modules.

emma (sec): Nice. For pinning strategy: prefer explicit minimal upgrade (no breaking API changes) and add a short changelog note mentioning the CVE. Also create a backport branch for 1.3.x runtime if possible.

luis (runtime): For older customer Dedicated images we should backport to 1.3.x and also stage a hotpatch build with our patched deps. If backport not trivial, we'll publish a 1.4.1 with the fix and a migration note.

raj (eng-runtime): PR #412 tests passing locally. I propose: merge to main -> build artefacts -> canary on dedicated-us-west (5% traffic) -> 30 min watch -> full rollout. If anything, auto-rollback via canary job.

deploy-bot: Canary job queued: runtime-canary-1987654321. Will notify channel on start/finish.

emma (sec): jwt: I created https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/259 to bump github.com/golang-jwt/jwt to v4.0.2 which contains the fix. The tricky piece: a few internal libraries vendor jwt in private forks. Sam, can you help enumerate?

sam (platform): on it. I'll run a repo search and post results within 2h. If we find forks, we either update forks or add a shim at compile-time. Also will check our KMS signing code to ensure we don't accept weird alg claims.

luis (runtime): small code snippet to force module pin in service go.mod (example):
```
require (
  google.golang.org/grpc v1.60.2
)
replace google.golang.org/grpc => google.golang.org/grpc v1.60.2
```
Use replace sparingly; aim for a clean require.

taylor (sre): monitoring playbook:
- pre-roll: snapshot 1h of p50/p95/p99 and error rates
- canary: 5% traffic for 30m, alert if p99 increases >20% or error rate >0.5%
- rollback: kubectl rollout undo and pin old image; page on call if auto-rollback triggers.

emma (sec): Notifications: prepare an internal advisory for SEs + account managers; don't send external customer notice unless we detect exploit attempts. Also add audit log note: KMS audit should show any signing anomalies in the period.

raj (eng-runtime): tagging owners on PRs: @luis to review runtime change, @taylor to sign-off canary steps, @sam to confirm no downstream jwt forks.

luis (runtime): will review today. If tests pass in CI, can merge. I'll also add an extra e2e that fuzzes grpc header parsing.

sam (platform): repo scan results: platform, auth-service, and metrics-ingest reference github.com/golang-jwt/jwt v3.x in go.mod; auth-service vendors a patched fork. I'll open PRs to bump to v4.0.2 and remove vendor where possible.

emma (sec): prioritization summary (actionable):
- P0: grpc bump (runtime PR 412) -> canary -> rollout (owners: raj/luis/taylor).
- P1: jwt bump + repo cleanup (platform PR 259 + service PRs) -> staged rollouts (owners: sam/emma).
- P2: net/http advisory -> schedule audit for older go builds and embed note in weekly infra sweep.

taylor (sre): I'll create incident channel #inc-1987654321 during canary and add runbook link.

deploy-bot: Canary started: runtime-canary-1987654321 on dedicated-us-west (5% traffic). Logs streaming: https://logs.redwood.ai/canary/1987654321

raj (eng-runtime): canary metrics look clean after 12m. No error spike, p99 unchanged. continuing to 30m.

luis (runtime): quick note: if we see any client-generated malformed header floods, we should rate-limit at edge LB before runtime. I'll open a ticket.

emma (sec): thanks everyone. I'll draft the internal advisory and the CVE tracking ticket in our vuln tracker. Assigning follow-ups in Asana.

sam (platform): PRs referenced: runtime#412, platform#259, auth-service#113, metrics-ingest#78. I'll follow up with the PR links when ready.

raj (eng-runtime): canary finished: stable. Merging PR 412 and kicking full rollout now.

deploy-bot: Full rollout started for runtime v1.4.1. Rolling update across regions. Notifying on completion.

emma (sec): closing loop: add note to release notes, update CVE ticket with mitigation steps and timeline.

(emoji reactions and short ack replies omitted for brevity)
